question: Is there a gym membership stipend?
queries: Is there a gym membership stipend?

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Internet stipend
results.text: Employees in approved fully remote roles receive an internet stipend of $50 per month, paid through payroll.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Daily meal allowance
results.text: When travelling on company business, the daily meal allowance is $75.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: High-cost cities
results.text: In New York, San Francisco and London, the daily meal allowance is $95.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Bereavement leave
results.text: Employees may take up to 5 paid days for the death of an immediate family member and up to 2 paid days for other relatives.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Limits
results.text: Client meals may cost up to $120 per person. A director must approve any client meal over $500 in total.
